description: Design and deploy a survey from research question through pilot testing to launch and response monitoring.

steps.description: Define the survey research question, target audience, and success criteria.

inputs.name: research-topic
inputs.desc: The subject area or question the survey will investigate

inputs.name: audience-description
inputs.desc: Who should respond to the survey (role, segment, demographics)

outputs.name: research-question
outputs.desc: The specific question the survey will answer

outputs.name: target-audience-profile
outputs.desc: Detailed profile of the intended respondent group

outputs.name: success-criteria
outputs.desc: Response rate target and minimum sample size

process: Clarify the decision the survey results will inform and write a single research question.
Define the target audience by relevant attributes (role, tenure, geography, usage level).
Set the target response rate, minimum sample size, and margin of error.
Identify any known biases or constraints that could affect the results.

steps.description: Select the survey method and distribution channel based on the audience and research question.

inputs.name: research-question
inputs.desc: The question the survey will answer

inputs.name: target-audience-profile
inputs.desc: Profile of the intended respondent group

outputs.name: survey-method
outputs.desc: The selected method (online, phone, in-person, intercept) with rationale

outputs.name: distribution-plan
outputs.desc: How the survey will reach respondents (email, in-app, SMS, link)

process: Evaluate each method (online, phone, in-person, intercept) against cost, response rate, and data quality.
Select the method that best fits the audience and research question.
Choose the distribution channels (email, in-app prompt, SMS, QR code, direct link).
Set the survey window (open date, close date, reminder schedule).

steps.description: Write the survey questions, avoiding common pitfalls like leading, double-barreled, and ambiguous items.

inputs.name: research-question
inputs.desc: The question the survey will answer

inputs.name: survey-method
inputs.desc: The selected survey method

outputs.name: question-list
outputs.desc: The ordered list of survey questions with response types

outputs.name: skip-logic-rules
outputs.desc: Conditional logic rules for question routing

process: Draft questions that directly address the research question, one concept per question.
Select the response format for each question (Likert scale, multiple choice, open text, ranking).
Review each question for leading language, double-barreled phrasing, and ambiguity.
Define skip logic rules so respondents only see questions relevant to their prior answers.
Order questions from general to specific, placing demographic questions at the end.

steps.description: Pilot test the survey with a small group to identify problems before full launch.

inputs.name: question-list
inputs.desc: The survey questions to test

inputs.name: skip-logic-rules
inputs.desc: The conditional routing rules to test

outputs.name: pilot-findings
outputs.desc: Issues found during pilot testing (confusing questions, broken logic, timing)

outputs.name: revised-survey
outputs.desc: The final survey instrument with pilot feedback incorporated

process: Select 5 to 10 pilot respondents who match the target audience profile.
Have each pilot respondent complete the survey while noting confusion or difficulty.
Review completion times, drop-off points, and skip logic paths.
Revise questions, instructions, and logic based on pilot feedback.

steps.description: Launch the survey and monitor response rates, taking action if rates fall below target.

inputs.name: revised-survey
inputs.desc: The final survey instrument ready for launch

inputs.name: distribution-plan
inputs.desc: How the survey reaches respondents

inputs.name: success-criteria
inputs.desc: Target response rate and sample size

outputs.name: response-data
outputs.desc: The collected survey responses

outputs.name: response-rate-report
outputs.desc: Actual response rate versus target, by segment and channel

process: Deploy the survey through the selected distribution channels.
Monitor response rates daily against the target.
Send reminders at the scheduled intervals to non-respondents.
Close the survey when the target sample size is reached or the window ends.
Export the response data and generate the response rate report.

steps.description: Analyze the survey results and produce the findings report.

inputs.name: response-data
inputs.desc: The collected survey responses

inputs.name: research-question
inputs.desc: The question the survey was designed to answer

outputs.name: survey-findings
outputs.desc: Key findings with statistical summary and segment breakdowns

outputs.name: survey-design-document
outputs.desc: Complete record of the survey design, method, and results

process: Clean the data (remove incomplete responses, check for straight-lining, remove duplicates).
Calculate descriptive statistics for each question (mean, median, distribution).
Segment the results by relevant audience attributes and test for significant differences.
Summarize the top findings in relation to the original research question.
Produce the survey design document with method, instrument, response rates, and findings.

description: Run a Net Promoter Score program from trigger configuration through response collection, detractor follow-up, and trend analysis.

steps.description: Define when and how to send NPS surveys based on customer journey touchpoints.

inputs.name: customer-journey-map
inputs.desc: The key touchpoints and milestones in the customer lifecycle

inputs.name: survey-goals
inputs.desc: What the NPS program should measure (relationship, transactional, or both)

outputs.name: nps-trigger-rules
outputs.desc: When each NPS survey fires (post-purchase, quarterly, post-support, renewal)

outputs.name: survey-frequency-caps
outputs.desc: Maximum survey frequency per customer to prevent fatigue

process: Identify the touchpoints where NPS measurement adds value (post-purchase, post-support, quarterly, renewal).
Set the trigger conditions for each touchpoint (days after event, transaction threshold).
Define frequency caps so no customer receives more than one NPS survey per quarter.
Document the suppression rules (open support tickets, recent survey, opt-out).

steps.description: Configure and distribute the NPS survey through the selected channels.

inputs.name: nps-trigger-rules
inputs.desc: When each NPS survey fires

inputs.name: survey-frequency-caps
inputs.desc: Maximum survey frequency per customer

outputs.name: nps-distribution-config
outputs.desc: The configured survey distribution (channel, template, timing)

outputs.name: distribution-metrics
outputs.desc: Delivery rate, open rate, and response rate by channel

process: Select the distribution channel for each trigger (email, in-app, SMS).
Write the survey invitation (subject line, body, NPS question, optional follow-up open text).
Configure the automation to fire surveys based on trigger rules and frequency caps.
Monitor delivery and open rates to verify the distribution is working.

steps.description: Collect NPS responses and segment them into promoters, passives, and detractors.

inputs.name: nps-distribution-config
inputs.desc: The active survey distribution configuration

inputs.name: distribution-metrics
inputs.desc: Delivery and response rates

outputs.name: segmented-responses
outputs.desc: Responses categorized as promoter (9-10), passive (7-8), or detractor (0-6)

outputs.name: nps-score
outputs.desc: The calculated NPS score (percent promoters minus percent detractors)

process: Collect all responses and validate the data (remove duplicates, check for bots).
Segment each response: promoter (9-10), passive (7-8), detractor (0-6).
Calculate the NPS score: percent promoters minus percent detractors.
Tag each response with customer attributes (segment, tenure, product, region) for later analysis.

steps.description: Follow up with detractors within the SLA to understand their concern and attempt recovery.

inputs.name: segmented-responses
inputs.desc: Responses with promoter/passive/detractor labels

inputs.name: nps-score
inputs.desc: The current NPS score for context

outputs.name: followup-log
outputs.desc: Record of each detractor follow-up (date, channel, outcome)

outputs.name: recovery-rate
outputs.desc: Percentage of detractors who were contacted and resolved

process: Route detractor responses to the follow-up team within the SLA (24 to 48 hours).
Contact the detractor to acknowledge their feedback and understand the root cause.
Log the follow-up outcome (resolved, escalated, no response, unresolvable).
Track the recovery rate and feed recurring themes to the product or operations team.

steps.description: Track NPS trends over time and produce the program report.

inputs.name: nps-score
inputs.desc: The current NPS score

inputs.name: followup-log
inputs.desc: Record of detractor follow-ups

inputs.name: recovery-rate
inputs.desc: Detractor recovery rate

outputs.name: nps-trend-report
outputs.desc: NPS score over time with segment breakdowns and commentary themes

outputs.name: nps-program-report
outputs.desc: Full program report with response rates, trends, follow-up outcomes, and recommendations

process: Plot the NPS score over time (monthly or quarterly) with segment breakdowns.
Identify statistically significant changes and correlate with business events.
Summarize the top themes from open-text comments by promoter and detractor groups.
Produce the program report with response rates, NPS trends, follow-up outcomes, and recommendations.

description: Close the feedback loop from collection through categorization, routing, resolution, and respondent communication.

steps.description: Categorize incoming feedback by theme, urgency, and source channel.

inputs.name: raw-feedback
inputs.desc: Unprocessed feedback from all sources (surveys, reviews, tickets, social)

inputs.name: category-taxonomy
inputs.desc: The list of feedback categories and subcategories to classify into

outputs.name: categorized-feedback
outputs.desc: Each feedback item tagged with category, urgency, source, and sentiment

outputs.name: category-volume-summary
outputs.desc: Count of feedback items per category and urgency level

process: Ingest feedback from all configured sources into a single queue.
Classify each item by category (product, service, billing, documentation, other).
Assign urgency (critical, high, medium, low) based on sentiment and business impact.
Tag each item with source channel and date for tracking.

steps.description: Route actionable feedback items to the responsible team for resolution.

inputs.name: categorized-feedback
inputs.desc: Feedback items with category, urgency, and sentiment tags

outputs.name: routed-items
outputs.desc: Feedback items assigned to a team with resolution SLA

outputs.name: routing-rules
outputs.desc: The rules used to assign items to teams

process: Match each feedback category to the responsible team (product, engineering, support, operations).
Assign a resolution SLA based on urgency level.
Send the feedback item to the assigned team with context (original text, source, customer info).
Flag items that match multiple categories for joint review.

steps.description: Track the resolution status of each routed feedback item against its SLA.

inputs.name: routed-items
inputs.desc: Feedback items assigned to teams with SLAs

outputs.name: resolution-status
outputs.desc: Current status of each item (open, in progress, resolved, overdue)

outputs.name: sla-compliance-rate
outputs.desc: Percentage of items resolved within SLA

process: Track each item through its lifecycle (open, in progress, resolved, closed).
Send reminders to the assigned team when items approach their SLA deadline.
Escalate overdue items to the team lead.
Calculate the SLA compliance rate by team and category.

steps.description: Communicate back to the respondent what was done about their feedback.

inputs.name: resolution-status
inputs.desc: Status and outcome of each feedback item

inputs.name: categorized-feedback
inputs.desc: Original feedback with respondent contact info

outputs.name: closure-messages
outputs.desc: Messages sent to respondents about their feedback outcome

outputs.name: closure-satisfaction
outputs.desc: Respondent satisfaction with how their feedback was handled

process: Draft a personalized response for each resolved item describing what was done.
Send the closure message through the original channel when possible.
Include a short satisfaction question (was this helpful, yes or no).
Log the closure and any follow-up response from the respondent.

steps.description: Produce the feedback closure report with volume, resolution, and satisfaction metrics.

inputs.name: sla-compliance-rate
inputs.desc: SLA performance by team and category

inputs.name: closure-satisfaction
inputs.desc: Respondent satisfaction with feedback handling

outputs.name: feedback-closure-report
outputs.desc: Report with feedback volume, resolution rates, SLA compliance, and satisfaction scores

process: Aggregate feedback volume by category, urgency, and source over the reporting period.
Calculate resolution rate and average time to resolution by team.
Report SLA compliance rate and identify teams or categories with chronic overdue items.
Include respondent satisfaction scores and produce the feedback closure report.

description: Build and manage a user research panel from recruitment through session scheduling and fatigue management.

steps.description: Define the panel membership criteria based on research needs.

inputs.name: research-agenda
inputs.desc: The upcoming research topics and questions for the next 6 to 12 months

inputs.name: user-segments
inputs.desc: The product's user segments and their attributes

outputs.name: panel-criteria
outputs.desc: The demographic, behavioral, and segment criteria for panel membership

outputs.name: panel-size-target
outputs.desc: Target panel size by segment with recruitment quotas

process: Review the research agenda to identify the user segments needed most frequently.
Define the panel criteria (demographics, usage level, tenure, geography, role).
Set the target panel size per segment, overrecruiting by 30 percent to account for attrition.
Document the inclusion and exclusion criteria.

steps.description: Recruit panel members who meet the defined criteria.

inputs.name: panel-criteria
inputs.desc: Criteria for panel membership

inputs.name: panel-size-target
inputs.desc: Target panel size per segment

outputs.name: recruited-members
outputs.desc: List of recruited panel members with segment tags and contact info

outputs.name: recruitment-metrics
outputs.desc: Recruitment conversion rate and segment fill status

process: Select recruitment channels (in-app prompt, email outreach, social media, customer community).
Send the recruitment invitation with a screening questionnaire to verify criteria.
Screen applicants against the panel criteria and segment quotas.
Onboard accepted members (consent form, incentive terms, communication preferences).

steps.description: Maintain the panel registry with member profiles, participation history, and incentive balance.

inputs.name: recruited-members
inputs.desc: Panel members with segment tags and contact info

outputs.name: panel-registry
outputs.desc: The active panel registry with profiles, history, and incentive balances

outputs.name: panel-health-metrics
outputs.desc: Active rate, attrition rate, and segment balance

process: Store each member's profile (segment, demographics, contact, consent status).
Track participation history (sessions attended, last participation date, total incentive paid).
Update incentive balances after each session and process payouts on schedule.
Flag inactive members (no participation in 6 months) and remove opted-out members.

steps.description: Schedule research sessions by matching study requirements to available panel members.

inputs.name: panel-registry
inputs.desc: The active panel registry

inputs.name: research-agenda
inputs.desc: The upcoming research topics and their participant requirements

outputs.name: session-schedule
outputs.desc: Scheduled sessions with confirmed participants and logistics

outputs.name: invitation-metrics
outputs.desc: Invitation acceptance rate by segment

process: Match the study's participant criteria to eligible panel members.
Apply fatigue rules (minimum days between invitations, maximum sessions per quarter).
Send invitations with session details, incentive, and scheduling options.
Confirm participants and send calendar holds and preparation materials.

steps.description: Monitor and manage panel fatigue to maintain engagement and data quality.

inputs.name: panel-registry
inputs.desc: The panel registry with participation history

inputs.name: invitation-metrics
inputs.desc: Acceptance rates by segment

outputs.name: fatigue-report
outputs.desc: Panel fatigue indicators by segment (declining acceptance, attrition spikes)

outputs.name: panel-management-plan
outputs.desc: Full panel management plan with recruitment, scheduling, and fatigue controls

process: Track acceptance rates over time and flag segments where rates are declining.
Enforce frequency caps (maximum invitations per month, minimum gap between sessions).
Rotate members within segments so the same individuals are not always selected.
Trigger recruitment for segments where active membership drops below the target.

description: Run a multi-touchpoint CSAT program with automated distribution, score aggregation, alerting, and reporting.

steps.description: Define the touchpoints where CSAT will be measured across the customer journey.

inputs.name: customer-journey-stages
inputs.desc: The stages and touchpoints in the customer lifecycle

inputs.name: measurement-goals
inputs.desc: What each touchpoint measurement should reveal

outputs.name: csat-touchpoint-map
outputs.desc: Each touchpoint with its survey trigger, question, and target score

outputs.name: touchpoint-ownership
outputs.desc: The team responsible for each touchpoint's score

process: List the customer journey touchpoints (onboarding, first value, support close, renewal, feature launch).
Select which touchpoints to measure based on business impact and feasibility.
Define the CSAT question and scale for each touchpoint (1-5, 1-7, or thumbs up/down).
Assign ownership of each touchpoint score to the responsible team.

steps.description: Configure the automated CSAT survey distribution at each touchpoint.

inputs.name: csat-touchpoint-map
inputs.desc: Touchpoints with triggers, questions, and targets

outputs.name: csat-automation-config
outputs.desc: The configured survey triggers and distribution rules

outputs.name: suppression-rules
outputs.desc: Rules to prevent survey fatigue (frequency caps, opt-outs)

process: Configure the trigger event for each touchpoint (ticket close, onboarding complete, renewal date).
Set the delay between event and survey (immediate, 1 hour, 24 hours) based on the touchpoint.
Define suppression rules: maximum one CSAT survey per customer per 30 days.
Test the automation with sample events to verify triggers fire correctly.

steps.description: Aggregate CSAT scores by touchpoint, segment, product, and team.

inputs.name: csat-automation-config
inputs.desc: The active survey automation configuration

inputs.name: touchpoint-ownership
inputs.desc: Team ownership of each touchpoint

outputs.name: csat-scorecard
outputs.desc: Aggregated scores by touchpoint, segment, product, and team

outputs.name: score-trends
outputs.desc: Score trends over time with period-over-period comparison

process: Collect responses from all active touchpoints into a single data store.
Calculate the CSAT score for each touchpoint (percent satisfied out of total responses).
Break down scores by customer segment, product line, and responsible team.
Compare current period scores to prior period and flag significant changes.

steps.description: Set thresholds and alerts for CSAT score drops so teams respond quickly.

inputs.name: csat-scorecard
inputs.desc: Current scores by touchpoint, segment, and team

inputs.name: score-trends
inputs.desc: Score trends and period comparisons

outputs.name: alert-config
outputs.desc: Alert thresholds and notification rules for score drops

outputs.name: triggered-alerts
outputs.desc: Alerts that fired with the score, threshold, and affected segment

process: Set the score threshold for each touchpoint (absolute floor and period-over-period drop).
Configure notifications to the touchpoint owner when a threshold is breached.
Log triggered alerts with the affected touchpoint, score, and segment.
Require an acknowledgment and action plan from the owner within the response SLA.

steps.description: Produce the CSAT program report with scores, trends, alerts, and recommendations.

inputs.name: csat-scorecard
inputs.desc: Aggregated scores

inputs.name: triggered-alerts
inputs.desc: Alerts that fired during the period

outputs.name: csat-program-report
outputs.desc: Full program report with scores, trends, response rates, alerts, and recommendations

process: Summarize scores by touchpoint with trend arrows and period comparison.
List the alerts that fired and their resolution status.
Highlight the top and bottom performing touchpoints and teams.
Recommend actions for underperforming touchpoints and produce the program report.

description: Run recurring employee pulse surveys from question selection through distribution, trend analysis, and manager reporting.

steps.description: Define the pulse survey cadence and question rotation strategy.

inputs.name: engagement-dimensions
inputs.desc: The dimensions to measure (engagement, manager, workload, culture, growth)

inputs.name: org-structure
inputs.desc: Teams, departments, and reporting hierarchy for result segmentation

outputs.name: pulse-cadence
outputs.desc: Survey frequency (weekly, biweekly, monthly) with question rotation plan

outputs.name: question-bank
outputs.desc: Pool of questions organized by dimension with rotation schedule

process: Select the survey cadence based on organization size and survey fatigue tolerance.
Build the question bank with 3 to 5 questions per dimension.
Design the rotation so each pulse includes 5 to 8 questions from different dimensions.
Include 1 to 2 anchor questions that repeat every cycle for trend tracking.

steps.description: Distribute the pulse survey and track participation rates.

inputs.name: pulse-cadence
inputs.desc: Survey frequency and rotation plan

inputs.name: question-bank
inputs.desc: Questions for the current cycle

outputs.name: pulse-responses
outputs.desc: Collected responses for the current cycle

outputs.name: participation-metrics
outputs.desc: Response rate by team, department, and tenure band

process: Select the questions for this cycle based on the rotation schedule.
Distribute the survey to all eligible employees via the selected channel (email, Slack, HRIS).
Send one reminder to non-respondents at the midpoint of the response window.
Close the survey and report participation rates by team.

steps.description: Analyze pulse survey trends by team, dimension, and time period.

inputs.name: pulse-responses
inputs.desc: Responses for the current and prior cycles

inputs.name: participation-metrics
inputs.desc: Response rates for context

outputs.name: dimension-scores
outputs.desc: Average scores by dimension, team, and tenure band

outputs.name: trend-analysis
outputs.desc: Score trends over the last 6 to 12 cycles with significant changes flagged

process: Calculate the average score for each dimension and team.
Compare to prior cycles and flag statistically significant changes.
Identify teams with consistently low or declining scores.
Analyze open-text comments for recurring themes.

steps.description: Build manager-level reports with team scores, trends, and action suggestions.

inputs.name: dimension-scores
inputs.desc: Scores by dimension and team

inputs.name: trend-analysis
inputs.desc: Score trends and flagged changes

outputs.name: manager-reports
outputs.desc: Team-level reports for each manager with scores, trends, and benchmarks

outputs.name: pulse-survey-report
outputs.desc: Organization-wide pulse survey report with all dimensions and trends

process: Generate each manager's report with their team's scores and organization benchmarks.
Highlight dimensions where the team is above or below the organization average.
Include suggested conversation starters for low-scoring dimensions.
Produce the organization-wide pulse survey report with executive summary.

description: Build a product feedback pipeline that collects from multiple sources, categorizes, scores, feeds into planning, and closes the loop.

steps.description: Collect product feedback from multiple sources into a single intake queue.

inputs.name: feedback-sources
inputs.desc: The channels to collect from (support tickets, surveys, sales calls, app reviews, social)

inputs.name: product-areas
inputs.desc: The product areas or modules for categorization

outputs.name: aggregated-feedback
outputs.desc: All feedback items in a single queue with source, date, and customer info

outputs.name: source-volume-breakdown
outputs.desc: Feedback volume by source channel

process: Configure integrations to pull feedback from each source into the central queue.
Normalize the data format (feedback text, source, date, customer ID, product area if known).
Deduplicate items from the same customer about the same topic.
Tag each item with its source channel for later analysis.

steps.description: Categorize feedback by product area and theme, then score by frequency and business impact.

inputs.name: aggregated-feedback
inputs.desc: All feedback items in the central queue

inputs.name: product-areas
inputs.desc: Product areas for categorization

outputs.name: scored-feedback
outputs.desc: Feedback items categorized by area and theme, scored by frequency and impact

outputs.name: theme-ranking
outputs.desc: Themes ranked by combined frequency and business impact score

process: Classify each item by product area and theme (feature request, bug, usability, performance).
Count the frequency of each theme across all sources.
Score the business impact of each theme (revenue at risk, churn signal, expansion blocker).
Rank themes by the combined frequency and impact score.

steps.description: Feed the top-ranked feedback themes into product planning.

inputs.name: theme-ranking
inputs.desc: Themes ranked by frequency and impact

outputs.name: planning-inputs
outputs.desc: Feedback themes formatted for the product planning process with evidence

outputs.name: theme-to-roadmap-map
outputs.desc: Mapping of feedback themes to roadmap items or backlog entries

process: Select the top themes that meet the planning threshold (minimum frequency or impact score).
Package each theme with representative quotes, customer count, and revenue context.
Submit the themes to the product planning intake process.
Map each theme to a roadmap item or backlog entry for tracking.

steps.description: Close the loop with customers who submitted feedback when their request ships.

inputs.name: theme-to-roadmap-map
inputs.desc: Mapping of feedback themes to roadmap items

inputs.name: aggregated-feedback
inputs.desc: Original feedback items with customer contact info

outputs.name: closure-notifications
outputs.desc: Messages sent to customers about shipped features they requested

outputs.name: feedback-pipeline-report
outputs.desc: Full pipeline report with volumes, themes, planning inputs, and closure rates

process: Monitor the roadmap for items that ship and match them to feedback themes.
Identify the customers who submitted feedback for each shipped theme.
Send a notification explaining what was built and how their feedback contributed.
Produce the pipeline report with intake volume, theme distribution, planning conversion rate, and closure stats.

description: Collect and analyze post-event feedback from survey design through distribution, analysis, and the findings report.

steps.description: Design the post-event feedback survey covering content, logistics, speakers, and overall satisfaction.

inputs.name: event-details
inputs.desc: Event name, type, agenda, speakers, and attendee count

inputs.name: evaluation-priorities
inputs.desc: What the organizer most wants to learn from the feedback

outputs.name: event-survey
outputs.desc: The event feedback survey instrument with questions and response types

outputs.name: distribution-timing
outputs.desc: When and how the survey will be sent to attendees

process: Write questions covering content quality, logistics, speaker ratings, networking value, and overall NPS.
Select the response format (1-5 scale for ratings, open text for comments, NPS for likelihood to recommend).
Keep the survey short (under 10 questions) to maximize completion.
Set the distribution timing (within 24 hours of event close) and channel (email, app notification).

steps.description: Distribute the event feedback survey and monitor response rates.

inputs.name: event-survey
inputs.desc: The event feedback survey instrument

inputs.name: distribution-timing
inputs.desc: When and how to distribute

outputs.name: event-responses
outputs.desc: Collected survey responses from attendees

outputs.name: event-response-rate
outputs.desc: Response rate and completion rate

process: Send the survey to all attendees within 24 hours of event close.
Send one reminder to non-respondents 48 hours after the initial send.
Monitor response and completion rates daily.
Close the survey after 7 days or when response rate plateaus.

steps.description: Analyze event feedback quantitative scores and qualitative comments.

inputs.name: event-responses
inputs.desc: Collected survey responses

inputs.name: event-details
inputs.desc: Event details for context

outputs.name: event-scores
outputs.desc: Average scores by question with distribution charts

outputs.name: comment-themes
outputs.desc: Top themes from open-text comments (positive and negative)

process: Calculate average scores and score distributions for each rating question.
Calculate the event NPS from the likelihood-to-recommend question.
Code open-text comments by theme and sentiment (positive, negative, neutral).
Rank themes by frequency and identify the top 3 strengths and top 3 improvement areas.

steps.description: Produce the post-event feedback report with scores, themes, and recommendations.

inputs.name: event-scores
inputs.desc: Average scores by question

inputs.name: comment-themes
inputs.desc: Top themes from comments

inputs.name: event-response-rate
inputs.desc: Response and completion rates

outputs.name: post-event-feedback-report
outputs.desc: Report with scores, NPS, themes, strengths, improvement areas, and recommendations

process: Summarize the overall event rating and NPS with comparison to prior events if available.
Present the top 3 strengths and top 3 improvement areas with supporting quotes.
List specific recommendations for the next event based on the findings.
Produce the post-event feedback report for the organizing team and stakeholders.

description: Run a 360-degree feedback review from competency definition through reviewer selection, data collection, and anonymized report delivery.

steps.description: Define the competency framework and rating scale for the 360 review.

inputs.name: role-levels
inputs.desc: The roles and levels being reviewed (individual contributor, manager, director)

inputs.name: org-values
inputs.desc: The organization's core values and leadership expectations

outputs.name: competency-framework
outputs.desc: The competencies and behaviors to evaluate, organized by role level

outputs.name: rating-scale
outputs.desc: The rating scale with definitions for each level (1-5 or frequency-based)

process: Select or adapt a competency framework aligned with the organization's values and role expectations.
Define 5 to 8 competencies per role level with 3 to 5 observable behaviors each.
Choose the rating scale (1-5 proficiency, frequency-based, or comparison to expectations).
Write clear definitions for each scale level to reduce rater interpretation differences.

steps.description: Select the reviewers for each participant based on their working relationships.

inputs.name: competency-framework
inputs.desc: The competencies and behaviors being evaluated

inputs.name: role-levels
inputs.desc: Participants and their roles

outputs.name: reviewer-assignments
outputs.desc: For each participant: self, manager, peers, and direct reports selected as reviewers

outputs.name: reviewer-guidelines
outputs.desc: Instructions for reviewers on how to provide useful feedback

process: For each participant, identify their manager, 3 to 5 peers, and all direct reports as reviewers.
Include self-assessment as a required component.
Verify each reviewer has sufficient working interaction to provide meaningful ratings.
Prepare reviewer guidelines explaining the purpose, scale, and confidentiality of the process.

steps.description: Distribute the 360 review forms and track completion.

inputs.name: reviewer-assignments
inputs.desc: Reviewer-to-participant assignments

inputs.name: reviewer-guidelines
inputs.desc: Instructions for reviewers

outputs.name: collected-reviews
outputs.desc: All completed review forms with ratings and comments

outputs.name: completion-rates
outputs.desc: Completion rate by reviewer type (self, manager, peer, direct report)

process: Distribute unique review forms to each reviewer with the participant's name and competencies.
Set the review window (typically 2 to 3 weeks) and send the deadline with the form.
Send reminders at the midpoint and 3 days before close to non-completers.
Close collection and verify minimum reviewer thresholds are met for each participant.

steps.description: Aggregate and anonymize the 360 review results for each participant.

inputs.name: collected-reviews
inputs.desc: All completed review forms

outputs.name: anonymized-reports
outputs.desc: Individual reports with aggregated scores and anonymized comments

outputs.name: aggregate-patterns
outputs.desc: Organization-wide patterns by competency and role level

process: Aggregate ratings by competency and reviewer group (self, manager, peers, direct reports).
Anonymize comments by removing identifying information (names, specific events with small audiences).
Flag competencies where self-ratings diverge significantly from others' ratings.
Calculate organization-wide averages by competency and role level for benchmarking.

steps.description: Deliver the 360 feedback report to each participant with context and guidance.

inputs.name: anonymized-reports
inputs.desc: Individual reports with aggregated scores and anonymized comments

inputs.name: aggregate-patterns
inputs.desc: Organization-wide benchmarks

outputs.name: delivered-reports
outputs.desc: Confirmation of report delivery to each participant

outputs.name: review-summary
outputs.desc: 360 review program summary with completion rates, patterns, and recommendations

process: Schedule a 1-on-1 debrief between each participant and their manager or a coach.
Deliver the report with context on how to read it (score interpretation, benchmark comparison).
Include a development planning template for the participant to set 2 to 3 focus areas.
Produce the program summary with completion rates, organization-wide patterns, and process improvements.

description: Build a sentiment tracking dashboard from source configuration through analysis pipeline, dashboard design, and alert setup.

steps.description: Define and connect the sentiment data sources.

inputs.name: sentiment-sources
inputs.desc: The sources to track (surveys, reviews, social mentions, support tickets)

inputs.name: tracking-scope
inputs.desc: What to track sentiment about (brand, product, feature, competitor)

outputs.name: source-connections
outputs.desc: Configured connections to each sentiment data source

outputs.name: data-schema
outputs.desc: The unified data schema for sentiment records (text, source, date, score)

process: List all sources that produce text with sentiment signal (surveys, reviews, social, tickets, app feedback).
Configure the data connection for each source (API, export, webhook, manual import).
Define the unified schema: text, source, date, customer or author, product area, raw sentiment.
Test each connection and verify data is flowing into the unified store.

steps.description: Configure the sentiment analysis method for the incoming data.

inputs.name: source-connections
inputs.desc: Active data source connections

inputs.name: data-schema
inputs.desc: The unified data schema

outputs.name: analysis-config
outputs.desc: The configured sentiment analysis method (keyword, NLP, manual, hybrid)

outputs.name: sentiment-scores
outputs.desc: Scored sentiment data with positive, neutral, and negative labels

process: Select the analysis method: keyword matching for simple cases, NLP scoring for volume, manual tagging for precision.
Configure the scoring rules (scale, thresholds for positive/neutral/negative classification).
Run the analysis on historical data to validate accuracy against a hand-labeled sample.
Set up the processing pipeline to score new data as it arrives.

steps.description: Build the sentiment tracking dashboard with trend lines and segment breakdowns.

inputs.name: sentiment-scores
inputs.desc: Scored sentiment data

inputs.name: tracking-scope
inputs.desc: What is being tracked (brand, product, feature)

outputs.name: sentiment-dashboard
outputs.desc: The dashboard with overall sentiment trend, source breakdown, and segment views

outputs.name: dashboard-refresh-schedule
outputs.desc: How often the dashboard updates (real-time, hourly, daily)

process: Design the dashboard layout: overall sentiment trend line, sentiment distribution, source breakdown.
Add segment views (by product, region, customer tier, time period).
Include a feed of the most recent negative items for quick review.
Set the refresh schedule based on data volume (real-time for high volume, daily for low).

steps.description: Set up alerts for significant sentiment shifts.

inputs.name: sentiment-dashboard
inputs.desc: The active sentiment dashboard

inputs.name: sentiment-scores
inputs.desc: Historical scored data for baseline

outputs.name: sentiment-alerts
outputs.desc: Configured alerts for sentiment shifts (threshold, notification channel, recipient)

outputs.name: sentiment-tracking-setup-document
outputs.desc: Complete setup document with sources, analysis, dashboard, and alerts

process: Define the alert conditions: sudden drop in positive ratio, spike in negative volume, new negative theme.
Set the thresholds based on historical baseline (percentage change, absolute count, z-score).
Configure the notification channel and recipients for each alert type.
Produce the setup document covering sources, analysis method, dashboard design, alert rules, and maintenance plan.
